properties.comment: Define keys for jettisoning goods from a ship
properties.entry: This ship cannot jettison goods now. It must be your ship at sea during your prepared turn.
Goods cannot be jettisoned while the turn is being prepared or ended.
This ship has no goods hold to jettison. Passengers stay aboard.
The ship or its hold changed, so nothing was discarded. Review the ship and try again.
Choose the goods hold of %s to empty in part. Nothing changes yet.
Discard goods from hold %s of %s. The ship stays at its place and receives no gold.
Discard %s %s from hold %s of %s? The ship stays at its place and receives no gold. Passengers and other holds stay aboard.
